title: Researcher onboarding examples and rustdoc for gf2-sim
description:
## Goal

Researcher-facing onboarding: `crates/gf2-sim/examples/` covering
DVB-T2 preset, 5G NR preset, and a novel-chain example via the
graph API. Rustdoc walk-through landing pages for the typestate
builder and the graph API.

## Context

Task under story `a5635da5` (5G NR LDPC real-time and research
enablers) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] `crates/gf2-sim/examples/` contains DVB-T2,
  5G NR, and graph-API novel-chain examples; each runs via
  `cargo run -p gf2-sim --example <name>` (or `--features hip`
  where applicable) and produces documented output.
- [hard] `doc-review` gate: rustdoc cover for `gf2-sim` provides
  a chain-construction quickstart, links to the example files,
  and explains the determinism contract.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
